command:
set -eu
fs_uuid=$(blkid -s UUID -o value /dev/vgdata/lvdata)
test -n "$fs_uuid"
cat > /usr/local/sbin/attach-vgdata <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
image=/var/lib/lvm-data/data-pv.img
if ! /usr/sbin/losetup -j "$image" | grep -q .; then
    /usr/sbin/losetup /dev/loop0 "$image"
fi
/usr/sbin/pvscan --cache /dev/loop0
/usr/sbin/vgchange -ay vgdata
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/attach-vgdata
cat > /etc/systemd/system/vgdata-loop.service <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Attach loop-backed physical volume for vgdata
DefaultDependencies=no
Wants=systemd-udev-settle.service
After=systemd-udev-settle.service
Before=local-fs-pre.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/attach-vgdata
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs-pre.target
ANTRIEB_EOF
if ! grep -q '[[:space:]]/srv/data[[:space:]]' /etc/fstab; then
    printf 'UUID=%s /srv/data xfs defaults,x-systemd.requires=vgdata-loop.service 0 0\n' "$fs_uuid" >> /etc/fstab
fi
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now vgdata-loop.service
systemctl is-enabled vgdata-loop.service
systemctl is-active vgdata-loop.service
printf 'filesystem_uuid=%s\n' "$fs_uuid"
grep '[[:space:]]/srv/data[[:space:]]' /etc/fstab
systemctl show -p Requires -p After srv-data.mount
